problems.title: Google Maps iframe loads eagerly (no loading=lazy) on 29/31 pages
problems.evidence: iframe tag in index.html (and 28 other HTML files): <iframe title='Map: Midvale, UT 84047' src='https://www.google.com/maps?q=Midvale%2C%20UT%2084047&output=embed' referrerPolicy='no-referrer-when-downgrade'> — no loading attribute at all. The request fires during initial render on 28/31 measured pages (observed as failed requests in the sandbox). The map sits below the fold, so every page view pays for a third-party embed (Maps JS + tiles) before the user ever scrolls to it.
problems.reasoning: P2, not P1: it does not block first paint (iframe) and local FCP/LCP/CLS are still clean, but it is a site-wide, every-page performance tax on real connections and a third-party dependency on every page. Fix: loading='lazy' on the iframe.

problems.title: Footer tap targets 26px tall on all 31 pages (25 of 30 header/footer targets under 48px)
problems.evidence: Measured at mobile 390 on every page: footer links all h=26 (e.g. About 53.9x26, Privacy Policy 119.9x26, phone 131.1x26), 25/30 targets <48px in height per page. Gaps ~16-17px between links, no overlap. Header: Menu 46x46, phone 151x46.6, brand 342x43.2.
problems.reasoning: P2, not P1: 26px passes the WCAG 2.2 AA 24x24 minimum and targets do not overlap, so taps are usable — but 26px is well under the 48px touch standard the audit set, it affects every page, and the footer phone link (the conversion action) is only 26px tall. Fix: raise footer link line-height/padding to >=48px hit area (or >=44px).

problems.title: Header Menu button 46x46 and phone link 46.6px tall — 2px under the 48px standard
problems.evidence: Header at mobile 390, all 31 pages: Menu button 46x46, phone link 151x46.6, brand 342x43.2 (wide, fine).
problems.reasoning: P3: 2px short of 48px, trivially close, both pass WCAG 2.2 AA; fix together with W4-P2-2 by bumping header button/link padding.

problems.title: 10 largest images are 185-341 KB (largest 340,588 B)
problems.evidence: images/body/magna-ut-1.webp 340,588; images/heroes/basement-flooding-spring-snowmelt-utah.webp 276,840; images/cards/cottonwood-heights-ut.webp 217,136; images/body/mold-remediation-1.webp 203,824; images/body/water-leak-detection-2.webp 200,484; images/body/cottonwood-heights-ut-2.webp 198,682; images/body/swamp-cooler-leak-water-damage-2.webp 198,018; images/heroes/cottonwood-heights-ut.webp 186,490; images/heroes/magna-ut.webp 186,350; images/body/storm-flood-damage-1.webp 185,028. Library total 107 webp = 11,694,402 bytes (~11.16 MiB).
problems.reasoning: P3, not higher: all are webp and lazy-loaded below the fold (only 4 images / 391,606 B load on the homepage at scroll-0; only the hero / 125,856 B on sewage-backup-cleanup), so no per-page load problem was observed. Further compression/resizing of the 10 largest is an optimisation opportunity only.

passes: Horizontal overflow 0 at 390px AND 320px on 31/31 pages (scrollWidth == innerWidth, measured in-browser).
Body font-size 19px, first paragraph 18px on 31/31 pages (18px+ expectation met).
Phone (385) 337-3560 present on 31/31 pages; H1 present on 31/31 pages.
CLS 0.0 on all 14 perf measurements (7 pages x 2 viewports).
Local FCP/LCP medians 168-336ms across 7 pages x 2 viewports (local only, noisy, not field data).
0 console errors, 0 failed requests, 0 bad HTTP responses apart from the sandbox-blocked Maps embed.
Single small render-blocking stylesheet (13.3 KB); all JS async; no render-blocking fonts (system stack).
Lazy loading works: homepage loads 4/20 images (391,606 B of 1,738,482 B inventory) at scroll-0; sewage page loads 1/4 images (125,856 B of 421,692 B).
verdict: PASS with 2 P2s and 2 P3s, 0 P1s. The site is fast and clean on the local render: no overflow anywhere, correct viewport, readable 18-19px type, CLS 0, no console/request errors. The two real fixes are (1) lazy-load the Google Maps iframe (eager third-party embed on 29/31 pages) and (2) raise footer tap targets from 26px toward 48px. Neither blocks a push on its own; both are cheap.
